email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoZanix patient with mild fatigue
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a nurse practitioner at Demo Family Practice (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 34-year-old male patient with a history of generalized anxiety disorder received their first dose of DemoZanix via subcutaneous injection.
Approximately 1 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed mild fatigue.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
J. Reyes (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
Contact: demo.reporter672@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
